properties.name: rate-limiter.key-prefix
properties.description: Trusted Redis key prefix. Logical keys are always hashed and never included in Redis keys.

properties.name: rate-limiter.key-hash-secret
properties.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret. Rotating it changes all state keys and requires coordinated deployment.

properties.name: rate-limiter.cache-maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of live local permit leases and bounded ramp-history entries.

properties.name: rate-limiter.ramp-up-duration
properties.description: Period in which exhausting a lease doubles the next demand-driven reservation batch.

properties.name: rate-limiter.lock-stripes
properties.description: Bounded power-of-two striped lock count used only for per-key refill single-flight.

properties.name: rate-limiter.redis.command-timeout
properties.description: Finite Lettuce command timeout. A timeout is an ambiguous execution and is never retried by the limiter.

properties.name: rate-limiter.policies
properties.description: Trusted server-defined policies keyed by immutable policy ID. expected-max-instances is a planning assumption; the real cache timing bound uses actual live lease holders.
